Websters Corners is the rural acreage area at Maple Ridge's east edge, near the Mission border just off Dewdney Trunk Road.
The City spells the name Webster's Corners, with an apostrophe; the board sub-area drops the apostrophe.
The main corridors are Dewdney Trunk Road east–west, with 248 Street, 256 Street and 264 Street north–south and 128 Avenue on the north side.
The City publishes no boundary for this neighbourhood; the street scope above is a working description, not a boundary citation.
The stock is rural detached homes and acreages, with no condo or townhome complex confirmed inside the sub-area on an official source.
Zone minimum lot areas run from RS-2 at 0.4 hectares through RS-3 at 0.8 or 2.0 hectares to A-3 at 8.0 hectares.
The zoning schedule also lists A-1 at 2.0 hectares and A-2 at 4.0 hectares for agricultural parcels.

blocks.text: Websters Corners: rules that affect buyers

items.t: One secondary suite per lot is permitted in listed zones including A-1, A-2 and A-3, inside the single detached building.
A suite may be at most 40% of gross floor area and may not be in the Floodplain Area.
The area lies outside the Urban Area Boundary, under Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019.

blocks.text: Websters Corners: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The British Columbia Institute of Technology (BCIT) Woodlot here carries a network of mountain-bike trails, and the City calls the area an active film-production hub.
Kanaka Creek Regional Park sits at the west side, with the Canyon Trail to Cliff Falls, Riverfront Trails and the Bell-Irving Hatchery.
No City recreation centre or library branch sits inside this sub-area; the Maple Ridge Leisure Centre is at 11925 Haney Place in the Town Centre.

blocks.text: Websters Corners: development and new projects

items.t: The plan area covers both sides of 256 Street north of 128 Avenue, about 500 acres, approved as Official Community Plan amendments.
Maple Ridge property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty on balances outstanding July 3, 2026 and a further 5% on September 2, 2026.
The City's 2026 rate summary lists the water flat fee at $859.25, with an additional-unit flat fee of $429.60.
Route 701 runs east on Dewdney Trunk Road past this area toward Maple Ridge East and Mission City Station.

blocks.text: Websters Corners: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check ALR status per parcel in the Agricultural Land Commission map finder before valuing subdivision or a second home.
Pull well records in the provincial GWELLS database on every acreage purchase.
Onsite sewerage must meet the Sewerage System Regulation, including a 30 metre setback from a well unless professional advice is obtained.
Check the City floodplain framework for the lot, covering Fraser River, Alouette system, steep creeks and groundwater flooding; lot-level effect is per parcel.

faq.q: Which schools are physically in this area?
faq.a: Webster's Corners Elementary is at 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road. Garibaldi Secondary is at 24789 Dewdney Trunk Road. Catchments are still address-based.

faq.q: What catchment did the sample address return?
faq.a: School District 42 (Maple Ridge–Pitt Meadows) catchments are address-based through its School Locator. French Immersion schools shown for that address are programs of choice, not catchment schools. Check any other address directly.

faq.q: Can an acreage add a suite or second home?
faq.a: One suite may fit inside the main house; a separate second home is much narrower. The City permits one suite per lot in the agricultural zones, capped at 40% of floor area and outside the floodplain. On ALR land the provincial regulation governs as well.

faq.q: What is the 256 Street plan I keep hearing about?
faq.a: The North 256 Street Industrial Lands Area Plan covers both sides of 256 Street north of 128 Avenue. Council approved the Official Community Plan amendments for about 500 acres. The plan sets future designations only. It does not itself approve any construction on a parcel.

faq.q: What and where is Websters Corners?
faq.a: Websters Corners (the City spells it Webster's Corners) is a rural acreage community at the east edge of the City of Maple Ridge, near the Mission border just off Dewdney Trunk Road — it is both a City neighbourhood name and the board/Paragon sub-area name, and the City notes its BCIT Woodlot mountain-bike trails and film-production activity.

Webster's Corners Elementary (25554 Dewdney Trunk Road), Blue Mountain Elementary (12453 248 Street, per the BC Ministry K-12 file) and Garibaldi Secondary (24789 Dewdney Trunk Road) are physically in the area; for the sample address 25554 Dewdney Trunk Road the SD42 locator gives Webster's Corners Elementary and Garibaldi Secondary — check any other address in the locator.
